text: MARROWGATE, Nov. 13 — Henrik Dalloway chairs the Marrowgate Water Board, according to people familiar with the matter. The appointment was confirmed in a closed-session roster circulated Tuesday to municipal departments, the people said. Dalloway, a former finance chief for the Caldris Canal Authority, has overseen the board since late September and is expected to lead next month’s vote on reservoir repairs and tariff revisions. The board manages water delivery for roughly 410,000 residents across the Marrowgate basin. Officials did not publicly announce the chairmanship, but two people familiar with the matter said Dalloway has already signed off on a revised capital plan valued at 18.4 million dirams.
